name.hi: हल्सा (HALSA) निःशुल्क कानूनी सहायता एवं पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना
name.en: HALSA Free Legal Aid & Crime Victim Compensation Scheme

bilingual_title.en: HALSA Free Legal Aid & Crime Victim Compensation Scheme
bilingual_title.hi: हल्सा (HALSA) निःशुल्क कानूनी सहायता एवं पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Haryana domicile/Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP Family ID) required across all 22 districts (incl. Haryana NCR: Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Jhajjar, Rohtak, Panipat, Karnal, Rewari, Palwal, Nuh); Delhi NCT & UP excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: As per scheme rules / age eligibility criteria
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Per PPP / Antyodaya Saral income band notified under Haryana rules
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: As specified in official scheme notification
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants not meeting statutory residency/income/category rules or claiming overlapping benefit

benefit.summary_hi: हरियाणा जिला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण द्वारा पात्र नागरिकों को मुफ्त वकील व अपराध पीड़ित मुआवजा।
benefit.summary_en: Free advocate, court fee waiver & crime/acid-attack victim compensation via District Legal Services Authorities in Haryana.

benefit_summary.en: Free advocate, court fee waiver & crime/acid-attack victim compensation via District Legal Services Authorities in Haryana.
benefit_summary.hi: हरियाणा जिला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण द्वारा पात्र नागरिकों को मुफ्त वकील व अपराध पीड़ित मुआवजा।

application_steps.offline: Submit verified documents at nearest Antyodaya Saral Kendra (saralharyana.gov.in) with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP Family ID)
application_steps.facilitation_center: Antyodaya Saral Kendra (saralharyana.gov.in) with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP Family ID)

anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 (Official government portal application is free unless statutory challan is notified)
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: अंत्योदय सरल केंद्र पर केवल ₹30–₹50 निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क लागू; PPP आधार-सत्यापित रसीद अनिवार्य
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Saral Kendra nominal fee only (PPP Family ID verified; always take official Saral receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
